title: Ablations borrow idle GPUs; a production run takes them back
purpose: Start an RL ablation that borrows both GPUs while production is idle. Then launch the production RL run: Kueue must preempt the borrower as a whole, admit production, and re-admit the ablation once production is done. Production is never preempted.

checks.description: the ablation is running on both GPUs, all of them borrowed
checks.because: The ablation queue owns no GPU, so its usage is entirely borrowed from production's idle quota.

checks.description: Kueue preempted the borrowing ablation to reclaim production's quota
checks.because: Production's queue has reclaimWithinCohort: Any. The ablation's usage is borrowed, so it is the one preempted.

checks.description: the ablation was stopped as a whole: none of its pods is left
checks.because: Kueue suspends the JobSet, and JobSet deletes every child Job, not one of them.

checks.description: the production RL run is admitted on its own quota (nothing borrowed)
checks.because: Production uses its nominal quota of two GPUs.
Nothing in the cohort may reclaim from production: the ablation queue has reclaimWithinCohort: Never and no quota to reclaim.

checks.description: the ablation was re-admitted once production finished
checks.because: The preempted Workload went back to its queue and was admitted as soon as the borrowed GPUs were idle again.
